## 紧急：修复 RoBERTa 模型文件损坏

服务器：gpu-6000pro-2
项目路径：/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est
Python 环境：source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

**严格按顺序执行。**

### Step 1: Kill 当前 RoBERTa 训练进程
```bash
kill 235755 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; ps -p 235755 -o pid= 2>/dev/null && kill -9 235755 || echo "KILLED"
```

### Step 2: 确认无并发下载进程
```bash
ps aux | grep -iE 'aria2|download|modelscope' | grep -v grep || echo "CLEAN"
```

### Step 3: 清理损坏文件
```bash
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/pytorch_model.bin
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.aria2
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.downloading
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.tmp
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/
```

### Step 4: 重新下载 roberta-base
AutoDL 环境下优先用 ModelScope 下载（速度快）：
```bash
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1

# 先尝试 ModelScope
pip install modelscope -q 2>/dev/null
python3 -c "
from modelscope import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('AI-ModelScope/roberta-base', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base-ms')
" 2>/dev/null

# 如果 ModelScope 成功，复制到目标目录
if [ -d /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base-ms ]; then
    echo "ModelScope download success"
    # 找到实际模型目录
    find /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base-ms -name "config.json" -path "*/roberta*" | head -1
fi
```

如果 ModelScope 失败，回退 HuggingFace：
```bash
python3 -c "
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained('roberta-base', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache')
model.save_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base')
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('roberta-base', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache')
tokenizer.save_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base')
print('HF download + save OK')
"
```

### Step 5: 验证模型完整性
```bash
python3 -c "
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
m = AutoModel.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base')
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base')
print('OK', sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()))
# 验证 forward pass
import torch
inputs = t('Hello world', return_tensors='pt')
out = m(**inputs)
print('Forward OK, hidden shape:', out.last_hidden_state.shape)
"
```

### Step 6: 防护检查
```bash
# 确认无残留标记文件
ls /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.aria2 /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.downloading /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/*.tmp 2>/dev/null && echo "WARNING: marker files exist" || echo "CLEAN: no marker files"
# 列出最终目录
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-base/
```

### 输出
打印每步的完整输出。最终报告：模型是否验证通过、参数量、目录内容。
